news.title: Everything We Know About GTA 7
news.summary: GTA 7 remains purely speculative, with no release date confirmed and no official details beyond the fact that GTA 6 has just been released.
news.author: Ari Notis

news.title: GTA 6 Players Are Officially Spending an ‘Absolutely Bonkers’ Amount of Time with the Game
news.summary: GTA 6 players logged an average of eight hours on launch day, a figure dubbed "absolutely bonkers."
news.author: Austin Manchester

news.title: Every Free Game This Week on Steam, Epic, and Xbox (Nov. 20-26)
news.summary: This week, free titles are available on Steam, Epic, and Xbox from Nov. 20‑26.
news.author: Ashely Claudino

news.title: 'Baldur’s Gate 3' Official Prequel Announced for 2027
news.summary: An official prequel novel for Baldur’s Gate 3 will dive into Shadowheart’s backstory, slated for release in 2027.
news.author: Sam Hill

news.title: 21% of Rockstar staff have been employed by the company for over 10 years, which explains a lot about GTA 6's record-breaking launch
news.summary: Rockstar’s 21% of staff with over a decade at the company helps explain GTA 6’s record launch, noting that "It's easier to make successful games when you hold onto the people who know how."
news.author: Lincoln Carpenter

news.title: Macaulay Culkin to Return as Kevin McCallister in Home Alone Sequel
news.summary: Macaulay Culkin has signed on to reprise Kevin McCallister in a new Home Alone sequel, now being produced by Disney.
news.author: Michael Cripe

news.title: GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, selling 32.5 million pre-sale copies and a bonkers $3.79 billion in its first day
news.summary: GTA 6 shattered records, selling 32.5 million pre‑sale copies and earning $3.79 billion on day one, surpassing the 13‑year‑old record set by its predecessor.
news.author: Kaan Serin

news.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 earned $3.79 billion on launch day
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 launched to $3.79 billion in revenue, with preorders topping 32.5 million copies.
news.author: Andy Chalk

news.title: After taking seven years to make Persona 6 and four years to make Persona 5, Atlus promises future games will come quicker
news.summary: Atlus vows future Persona titles will develop faster, noting that Persona 6 has taken seven years and Persona 5 four years to complete.
news.author: Kaan Serin

news.title: GTA 6 credits actually include 'Florida Joker', the viral internet personality who once demanded $10 million from Rockstar Games
news.summary: Lawrence Sullivan, the real name of the Florida Joker, is now credited in GTA 6 after a settlement with Rockstar.
news.author: Kaan Serin

news.title: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang accused of decades of bullying and workplace abuse in new investigation
news.summary: Nvidia co‑founder Jensen Huang resigned after a series of extramarital affairs were revealed, and an investigation uncovered decades of harassment and "cultish" behaviour at the company.
news.author: Robert Purchese

news.title: GTA 6 Has Only Been Out For a Day and People Are Already Asking Take-Two's Boss About GTA 7
news.summary: Within 24 hours of launch, Take‑Two CEO Strauss Zelnick is already being queried about a future GTA 7 release.
news.author: Rachel Weber

news.title: GTA 6 Doesn't Officially Have First-Person, but You Can Force It to — Here's How to Do It
news.summary: Players can force GTA 6 into first‑person by executing a specific sequence of button presses, a trick discovered after the game’s launch.
news.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

news.title: Persona 7 Already Teased Before Persona 6 Has an Official Release Date
news.summary: Kazuhisa Wada says Persona 6 won’t be the final entry and future titles will roll out faster.
news.author: Willa Rowe

news.title: Battleground Cleaner Simulator Announced for PC
news.summary: Battleground Cleaner Simulator lets players scrub post‑battle chaos, from Game of Thrones‑style medieval skirmishes to tavern brawls and feasts.
news.author: Ryan McCaffrey

news.title: GTA 6 Learned All the Right Lessons From Zelda: Breath of the Wild
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 reportedly adopts the 2017 Zelda lesson of a flawless opening sequence, aiming for a similarly polished introduction.
news.author: Giovanni Colantonio

news.title: 'Cousin! We Should Hang Out!' GTA Secret Quests Referencing Roman Bellic Added to Fortnite
news.summary: Fortnite’s new secret quests reference GTA 4’s Roman Bellic, including the famous “Cousin! We should hang out!” meme, and are available in the game’s current season.
news.author: Tom Phillips

news.title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 breaks the game into star system mini-campaigns, each with their own stories and objectives
news.summary: Creative Assembly plans to split the upcoming Total War: Warhammer 40,000 into star‑system mini‑campaigns, each with unique stories and objectives.
news.author: Connor Makar

news.title: Amid a year of layoffs, Ubisoft yank the cover off Motherbrain, their new studio "focused on AI for gameplay innovation"
news.summary: Ubisoft unveils Motherbrain, a new studio focused on generative AI for gameplay, staffed by the team behind the company’s first playable generative AI experience.
news.author: Mark Warren

news.title: WoW: Forever item designer wants to 'get rid of BiS', encouraging players who want to sweatily optimise to bring unique sets of gear to raids
news.summary: Designer urges BiS to vary per boss, saying "I think your BiS should be different every single boss."
news.author: Harvey Randall

news.title: 'I've done some stupid stuff', says WoW: Forever dev who's adding unique, fun items to the game: 'There's a lot they've not seen that I'm very happy with'
news.summary: The developer reveals new unique items, including a master looter BiS, being added to World of Warcraft.
news.author: Harvey Randall

news.title: GTA 6 day-one sales are enormous, estimates suggest, making previous $2 billion opening weekend predictions seem conservative
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 reportedly sold nearly 25 million copies in its first day, generating about $2.5 bn in revenue, far surpassing earlier $2 bn opening weekend forecasts.
news.author: Robert Purchese

news.title: Every Future Driving Game Needs to Steal This GTA 6 Feature
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 will let players cruise at the speed limit thanks to the PS5 DualSense adaptive triggers, a feature that could set a new standard for driving games.
news.author: Oli Welsh

news.title: Ubisoft Says Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Boosted Assassin's Creed Odyssey Sales
news.summary: Ubisoft reports a fresh surge in back‑catalog sales for 2018's Assassin's Creed Odyssey, citing Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey as the catalyst.
news.author: Tom Phillips

news.title: GTA 6 Players Find Red Dead Redemption Lore That Strongly Suggests Both Series Are Set in the Same Universe
news.summary: GTA 6 lore hints at a canon merger of timelines with Red Dead Redemption, sparking fan excitement.
news.author: Kirk McKeand

news.title: GTA 6 leaker claims to have lobbed a near-complete Xbox build of Rockstar's crimsim onto the net, shouts that the "community will have it emulated inside a week"
news.summary: Leaker claims to have a nearly complete Xbox build of GTA 6 and threatens to release the main executable unless cryptocurrency value is raised.
news.author: Mark Warren

news.title: Cyberleek Returns for GTA 6 Launch to Reportedly Release a Near-Complete Xbox Build, Threatens to Release the Game's Executable in Days
news.summary: Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 and claims it will release a near‑complete Xbox build, threatening to drop the game’s executable within days.
news.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

news.title: Valve are pausing Steam Machine 2TB orders over "supply constraints," though the 512GB model is free of its waitlist
news.summary: Valve has paused new 2TB Steam Machine orders due to supply constraints, but existing 2TB reservation holders will still receive purchase invites.
news.author: James Archer

news.title: "You broke my heart" - popular artist Doja Cat gutted to not have her music in Grand Theft Auto 6
news.summary: Doja Cat is upset that her music is missing from GTA 6’s radio stations, despite the game’s launch earlier this week.
news.author: Connor Makar

news.title: Blizzard wants to "get rid" of best-in-slot items in World of Warcraft: Forever by introducing situationally strong gear
news.summary: Blizzard plans to break the BIS mindset in WoW: Forever by introducing situationally strong gear, with the first raids launching in early December.
news.author: Connor Makar
